goal: Select a buildable first native semantic foundation that can become a real ancestor of the Alice personality model without a separate architecture tournament.
procedure: Choose a modern bidirectional encoder architecture from completed research, set a credible initial scale, choose a public-only byte-fallback tokenizer, constrain training data to training-allowed manifest entries, and defer scale/tokenizer changes until observed model failures justify them.
authority: Selects active initial build configuration; does not authorize private identity gradient training.
validation: Configuration is internally dimension-consistent: 896 hidden width / 14 heads = 64 dimensions per head. Approximate scale is ~350M and remains revisable from observed failures.
failure_or_lesson: A useful initial build decision can be made from existing research without spending time on a broad parameter/architecture qualification tournament.
notes: First live example of parallel Alice-build/FBM capture after the contract was adopted.
